title: Rendlesham Forest
dek: Over three nights in December 1980, airmen from two adjacent USAF bases in Suffolk reported lights in the forest, and a deputy base commander recorded his own account on tape.
also_known_as: Rendlesham, the Halt incident, Britain's Roswell

facts.witnesses: USAF personnel from Bentwaters and Woodbridge
facts.outcome: The Halt memo was released in 1983; the MoD closed its file without a determination.

prose.label: What happened
prose.body: Security patrols investigated lights descending into the forest. On a later night, Lt Col Halt led a party with a cassette recorder; the tape and his memo became the public face of the case.

prose.label: The lighthouse account
prose.body: Sceptics identify the flashing beam of Orfordness Lighthouse with the lights Halt described. Believers argue the geometry and timing do not close the case.
